name: Nogami Ai
source:
Likes: All living things; All of the lovable people (so she says), Coke, potato chips
Hates: Working, boredom

Ai is the owner of Oukoku-kan and the president of the Hatsunejima student discipline committee. Her real age is unknown; despite her not being a student, she always wears a school uniform because "it's cute".

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=684461]Getchu[/url]]
